source_row.extraction_instructions: Server-rendered Sigma ticketing portal. Listing /events?page=N (about 20 cards a page; walk until a page adds no new card). Card: data-url=/<id>, title, 'DD Month YYYY', ' - location'. Detail /<id>: h1, .mvp_date, .mvp_address, .mvp_ticket blocks (label + FREE/price chip + Fully Booked badge), .mvp_body description. Titles are filtered by a clinical/education cue list minus an admin/comms/IT drop list; dropped titles are logged.

registry_comment: NHS England events portal (156): server-rendered Sigma listing, clinician-CPD title gate, free/paid ticket blocks; GBP
concerns: Relevance gate (Level 2): the portal lists 59 upcoming events over 4 pages; 31 are kept by a title rule (clinical / education / clinical-leadership cue AND no admin cue; unmatched titles DEFAULT TO DROPPED). Dropped titles are logged at INFO (e.g. Spend Comparison inductions, Copilot, CIPD routes, communications/speechwriting/finance courses, co-production forums, Staff Survey, supplier open days, NHS App webinar, Clock Club). The rule is conservative: some borderline items (e.g. AEMHP focus groups, Staff Standard: Violence Prevention) are dropped; extend the cue lists in nhs_england_events.py if the owner wants more.

Most kept events are free NHS England webinars on Teams (with_venue is low because location is online/TBC): one 0.00 tier from the FREE chip, ticket names that echo the title become 'Registration'. Paid tickets would be parsed from the price chip (none seen). Events with 'Ticket sales finished' show no ticket block, so no tiers.

Specialty is the shared title classifier only (page text mis-tagged a renal day as Cardiology) plus a few title cues; the classifier's General Practice catch-all is ignored unless the title says GP/primary care; default 'Multi-specialty'. Location TBC events are marked online only when the title/body says webinar/online/Teams.

Pagination: walks ?page=N until a page adds no new card (cap 12); 0.5 s between pages. robots.txt only disallows admin/basket/search paths. Booking URLs redirect to /events/<slug>; fine. No LLM calls. Tests: test_nhs_england_events.py.

FM3: event_format is set for every row when the location block or text gives a cue: venue -> in_person, Teams/webinar/online -> online, and now 'Location TBC' with a learning-programme cue (animation-based, e-learning, self-paced) or a date span over 14 days -> online (the physiotherapy-education programme row, 2 Dec 2026 - 28 Apr 2027). TBC with no cue stays null rather than a guess. City only when an address gives one. Two other audit SUSPECT descriptions (Smarter Outpatients 3773, Cultural Awareness for Educators 3789) share no title word and are not in this ticket.
